mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_article_collect(user_id, article_id, operation_count, last_collect_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{articleId}, 1, NOW())
INSERT INTO sys_user_article_history(user_id, article_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{articleId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_article_like WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND article_id = #{articleId}
mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.user_id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover, a.content_md, a.quantity, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.first_accessed_time, a.last_accessed_time, a.favorite_num as favorite_num, c.name AS categoryName, u.nickname, u.avatar, (SELECT COUNT(sc.id) FROM sys_comment sc WHERE sc.article_id = a.id) AS comment_num, (SELECT COUNT(sal.id) FROM sys_article_like sal WHERE sal.article_id = a.id) AS like_num FROM sys_article a LEFT JOIN sys_category c ON a.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.user_id = u.id WHERE a.status = 'publish' AND a.is_archive = 0
AND a.id in (SELECT article_id FROM sys_article_tag WHERE tag_id = #{tagId})
AND a.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND a.title like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')
order by a.create_time desc

SELECT a.id, a.user_id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover, a.content_md, a.content, a.quantity, a.read_type, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.first_accessed_time, a.last_accessed_time, a.ai_describe, a.favorite_num as favorite_num, c.id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, u.nickname, u.avatar, (SELECT COUNT(sc.id) FROM sys_comment sc WHERE sc.article_id = a.id) AS comment_num, (SELECT COUNT(sal.id) FROM sys_article_like sal WHERE sal.article_id = a.id) AS like_num FROM sys_article a LEFT JOIN sys_category c ON a.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.user_id = u.id where a.id = #{id}
SELECT DATE_FORMAT( create_time, '%Y' ) AS YEAR FROM sys_article WHERE status = 'publish' AND is_archive = 1 GROUP BY YEAR order by YEAR desc
select id,title,create_time from sys_article where status = 'publish' AND is_archive = 1 and DATE_FORMAT( create_time, '%Y' ) = #{year} order by create_time desc
SELECT DATE_FORMAT( create_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) AS `date`, COUNT( id ) AS count FROM sys_article WHERE date(create_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) group by `date` order by `date` asc
SELECT COUNT( id ) > 0 AS isLike FROM sys_article_like WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND article_id = #{articleId}
SELECT COUNT( id ) > 0 AS isCollect FROM sys_article_collect WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND article_id = #{articleId}
SELECT c.name AS name, COUNT( a.id ) AS value FROM sys_article a LEFT JOIN sys_category c ON a.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name

SELECT b.id, b.title, b.summary, b.cover, a.create_time, b.user_id, b.quantity, c.nickname as author FROM sys_article_like a LEFT JOIN sys_article b ON a.article_id = b.id LEFT JOIN sys_user c ON b.user_id = c.id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_article_collect_log( user_id, article_id, action_type, result_code, rate_limit_count, rate_limit_threshold, request_uri, client_ip, create_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{articleId}, #{actionType}, #{resultCode}, #{rateLimitCount}, #{rateLimitThreshold}, #{requestUri}, #{clientIp}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.title, b.summary, b.cover, a.update_time as create_time, b.user_id, b.quantity, c.nickname as author FROM sys_user_article_history a LEFT JOIN sys_article b ON a.article_id = b.id LEFT JOIN sys_user c ON b.user_id = c.id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.update_time DESC

SELECT b.id, b.title, b.summary, b.cover, a.create_time, b.user_id, b.quantity, c.nickname as author FROM sys_article_collect a LEFT JOIN sys_article b ON a.article_id = b.id LEFT JOIN sys_user c ON b.user_id = c.id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.cover, a.summary, a.create_time, a.favorite_num as favorite_num, (SELECT COUNT(sc.id) FROM sys_comment sc WHERE sc.article_id = a.id) AS comment_num, a.quantity AS quantity, (SELECT COUNT(sal.id) FROM sys_article_like sal WHERE sal.article_id = a.id) AS like_num FROM sys_article a LEFT JOIN article_stat_daily asd ON a.id = asd.article_id
AND asd.date >= #{startTime}
WHERE a.status = 'publish' AND a.is_archive = 0 GROUP BY a.id, a.title, a.cover, a.summary, a.create_time, a.favorite_num, a.quantity ORDER BY
like_num DESC
quantity DESC
like_num DESC, quantity DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
